description: Start a full scan of a public website that the user names. The scan requests each page the way common search and AI crawlers do, compares each response with a rendered browser view, and scores six SEO, AEO and GEO categories. Each scan counts against the user's monthly plan quota. Returns a scan_id. A scan takes 1 to 5 minutes.
name: scan_site
title: Start an AI visibility scan
